en.title: FOB vs CIF Quote Check for Chinese Vehicles Imported into Southeast Asia
en.seo_title: FOB vs CIF Quote Check for Southeast Asia: Singapore Valuation and Malaysia AP
en.meta_description: Compare a China-to-Southeast-Asia FOB or CIF vehicle quote through to registration: Singapore customs value and four-step import process, the 3-year used-car rule and S$10,000 surcharge, and Malaysia's personal-vehicle Approved Permit via ePermit.
en.summary: The ocean quote is only the main voyage; the feeder leg, permits and registration are priced separately. Singapore adds charges to customs value and caps used-car age; Malaysia's personal-vehicle AP is its own pre-import gate and does not cover commercial or fleet import.
en.method: Document research and procurement analysis of official Singapore Customs, LTA and Malaysia MITI sources set against the Incoterms 2020 framework. Statements are bounded to Singapore or to Malaysia's personal-vehicle import route; Singapore and Malaysia do not represent the whole region.
en.ai_disclosure: Prepared by the AutoBridge Export Editorial Team with AI assistance for source organization, drafting, revision and translation. This is AI-assisted independent review, not human editorial sign-off; final editorial review is pending.
en.evidence_boundary: No first-hand inspection, transaction, interview or ownership is claimed. The Malaysia personal-vehicle Approved Permit route is documented, but the commercial, dealer and fleet import route is not verified in the captured evidence; Thailand, Indonesia, Viet Nam and the Philippines rules, written carrier acceptance and live rates are not captured and must be confirmed before payment.

zh.title: 中国汽车出口东南亚：FOB 与 CIF 报价核验（新加坡、马来西亚）
zh.seo_title: 东南亚 FOB 与 CIF 报价核验：新加坡估价与马来西亚 AP 准证
zh.meta_description: 把中国到东南亚的 FOB/CIF 汽车报价一直核到注册：新加坡完税价格与四步进口流程、二手车 3 年车龄上限与 S$10,000 附加费，以及马来西亚个人车辆 ePermit AP 准证。
zh.summary: 海运报价只是主航程，支线航段、准证与注册需另行计价。新加坡在完税价格上加收费用并限制二手车龄；马来西亚个人车辆 AP 是独立的进口前关口，不覆盖商业或车队进口。
zh.method: 针对新加坡海关、LTA 与马来西亚 MITI 官方来源做文献研究与采购分析，并与 Incoterms 2020 框架对照；表述分别限定于新加坡、以及马来西亚个人车辆进口路径，不以新加坡、马来西亚代表整个区域。
zh.ai_disclosure: 由 AutoBridge Export Editorial Team 编写，AI 协助完成来源整理、起草、修订与翻译。这是 AI 辅助的独立审阅，并非人工编辑签发，最终编辑审阅仍在进行中。
zh.evidence_boundary: 本页不主张任何一手检测、交易、采访或持有经历。马来西亚个人车辆 AP 路径有据，但商业、经销商与车队进口路径在已采集证据中未核实；泰国、印尼、越南、菲律宾规则、承运人书面受理条件与实时费率均未采集，付款前须确认。
